title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
鼎沸喧哗中冲出一声开赛哨响，眨眼的功夫，Owen出了记直拳，17号反应迅速地抬肘格挡，侧闪躲过。“这拳套真薄，8盎司都没有吧，估计只有6，容易把指骨打断。”贺蔚嚼着口香糖，“不过在这种地方，一般戴厚拳套的都有猫腻。”他靠过去，单手握拳，在陆赫扬右侧肋骨上挨了挨：“有人会在拳套里塞碎玻璃，往肋骨下面，就这儿——肝的位置，砸一拳过去，对面的人就别想起来了。”地下场子里，拳手大多玩得脏，看客们并不在意，甚至还为此欢呼喝彩——本就是奔着刺激和血腥味来的，巴不得场面再疯狂惨烈一点。开场没十几秒，17号明显落了下风，Owen一直用速度极快的刺拳干扰他的进攻节奏，同时不断攻击他的头部和下腹。17号接连后退，眼看就要退到八角笼边缘。不少观众已经从位置上站起来，嘶吼大喊：“他妈的反击啊！干他！”Owen凭借量级优势，开始用重拳破17号的格挡。在持续的防守中，17号的左手格挡被Owen攻破，紧接着Owen借机挥起直拳正面砸在他脸上，鲜红的鼻血登时喷出来，溅在脚下灰色的橡胶垫上。尖叫和呼喊声震耳欲聋，有人已经围到八角笼附近，像汹涌的蚁群，抓着钢丝网冲里面的拳手大喊。到底是在斥骂还是鼓励都不重要，这种比赛只为刺激观众的肾上腺素，用拳手的搏斗和鲜血供他们放肆发泄，愤怒、激动、欢畅……只要挑起其中任何一种，就算成功。“一场打几个回合？”陆赫扬看着低头背靠在钢丝网边用手肘擦血的17号，忽然问。“这儿的赛制没有回合一说，打到其中一个人完全爬不起来就算结束。”贺蔚手肘撑在膝头，身体往前倾，盯着赛场，“一般是这样，有些时候会开擂台赛。”八角笼里，17号缓缓直起身，抬手，两只拳套轻轻一撞，然后走回场地正中。Owen扭了扭脖子，在原地开脚站架，等17号走到面前，他吐着舌头挑衅地做了个充满侮辱性的鬼脸，场上顿时又沸腾起来，大骂的叫好的，不过17号似乎并没受到什么影响，他收拢双臂恢复预备姿势，微微弓起背。又是一连串飞速的刺拳，17号再次被击中鼻子，血顺着他尖瘦的下巴往下流，混合着脸上的油彩，看起来一塌糊涂。Owen气焰嚣张地向他逼近，拳拳朝着要害去。17号又被逼到了边缘位置，陆赫扬听见周围那些给17号下了注的观众纷纷骂起脏话，抱怨他怎么连个新来的拳手都打不过……但忽然间，那些骂声又化成了兴奋的惊呼，因为一直处于防守地位的17号忽然下潜闪身转换了交锋位置，接着回手一个上勾拳打中Owen的下巴。这一拳实实在在，把Owen打得有些懵，反应过来后重新发起进攻，17号连续闪过，出了一个直拳击腹的假动作，随后紧跟上一记右勾拳，准确击中Owen的左脸。在所有人还没有看清他的这套动作时，Owen的头已经歪到一边，护齿沾着带血的唾液，直接从嘴里被打了出来。17号像只苏醒后力量爆发的雪豹，沉静、果断、迅速、出拳干脆、一击即中，反将Owen渐渐逼入角落。那种毫不迟疑的冷静的霸道侵略性化成一记接一记的直拳勾拳，闪电坠地似地迸开来，将整个场馆点燃，众人的高呼声快要撞破耳膜。“真聪明！知道这些人就吃这一口反转。”贺蔚从位置上站起来，浑身肌肉都亢奋地绷紧。最后一刻，17号出了一个力道十足的后手拳，正中Owen的面门。Owen仰头吐出一口血，整个人往后撞在钢丝网上，又被弹回来，直挺挺趴在地上。血在脑袋下慢慢淌开，Owen撑着手试图爬起来，但次次都摔了回去，显然已经不具备任何还击能力。“没死就起来！打！”“接着打！打啊！”“别停！打死他！”观众们挥舞着拳头嘶声呐喊，台裁没叫停也没读秒，意味着17号可以继续补拳——任何规则在这里都不适用，只要他想，他可以把Owen打到抽搐昏死在台上，让血流得再多一点，满足看客们残忍嗜血的愿望。但17号只是双手交叉做了个停止的动作，然后摘下圈套和护齿，推开八角笼的门，从选手通道走回后台。许多人大喊着把酒瓶和烟头扔进八角笼，扔到Owen周围或背上，不过很快就有人拿着担架进去，将Owen抬走。场地被清理干净，新的拳手上场，开始新的比赛。贺蔚坐回位置上，嘴里的口香糖已经没什么味道了，但他还在嚼：“真带劲，17号的腹肌和胸肌够漂亮的，那腰，那腿。”“不止。”陆赫扬说。“什么？”“背肌也不错。”说完，陆赫扬站起来往外走。“不看啦？”贺蔚问他。“出去透个气。”

晚上十一点多，两人离开地下俱乐部。贺蔚开着车，突然说：“17号既然是s级，如果档案有记录的话，预备校应该找过他啊。就算没钱读书，学校也会给他免学费和补贴，至于来打野拳么。”陆赫扬靠在椅背上：“可能太缺钱了。”“其实在这种地方赚不到多少钱，真要捞钱，肯定还是打职业赚得多，商业价值完全不一样。”贺蔚说，“看17号的样子，估计以前受过专业训练，不知道为什么在这儿混。”“说不定——”陆赫扬看着前路，右手搭在膝头，食指指尖在膝盖上轻轻点了几下，他接着说，“17号就在预备校里。”贺蔚一怔，转头看了他一眼，接着笑起来：“不可能吧，怎么可能啊。”“嗯。”陆赫扬应了声，“我也觉得。”周一，最后一节课下课，陆赫扬去游泳馆等贺蔚。天很阴，像是要下雨，闷得人喘不过气。陆赫扬绕过花坛，往游泳馆台阶上走，正遇到一个alpha从里面出来，手上拎着塑料袋，低着头，脚步有点急。许则往下迈了一个台阶后才意识到有人，想躲避已经来不及，撞上去的那刻，对方那张冷淡的面容近距离地在眼前闪过。太近了，许则甚至能看到他根根分明的睫毛，长而黑，瞳孔也很黑，抬眼看过来的时候，显得没什么温度。他感觉自己的上臂被一只手扣住片刻，按理说，被扶了那么一下，他应该站稳了的——但许则反而更慌乱地趔趄了一步，一脚踩进台阶侧边的草地，塑料袋里的东西掉出来，发出玻璃碰撞的声音。乌云阴沉沉的，仿佛要压下来了。许则抬头看了陆赫扬一眼，匆忙的一眼，接着他很快移开视线，俯身去捡地上的东西，边捡边说：“对不起。”他的耳朵有点红，看起来确实是十分抱歉的样子。“是我的问题，没及时往旁边让。”陆赫扬弯腰帮他捡。许则的声音低哑，呼吸也有些急促，让人理所当然地以为他是生病了，来医务室看病。但陆赫扬同时也看见，许则的鼻子上贴着纱布，边缘露出一小块青紫色皮肤，嘴角也有点肿，如果光看他这模样，又更像是跟人打完架之后来配药。不过掉在地上的并不是感冒药或跌打药，而是几支一次性注射器和针剂瓶。捡最后一个针剂瓶时，两人同时伸出手，指尖不小心碰在一起，许则瞬间收回手，陆赫扬于是把瓶子捡起来，看到上面印着“alpha抑制剂”的字样。陆赫扬对alpha抑制剂不太熟悉，s级在信息素的自控能力方面有天生优势，在没有受到严重刺激的情况下一般不会发情，就算一年中很偶然地出现一两次易感期，也仅仅是轻微的发热症状而已，严重不到什么地步。作为s级，用到alpha抑制剂算是种很罕见的情况。陆赫扬什么也没说，把那管抑制剂递过去，许则伸手接下，立刻塞进塑料袋里，低声说：“谢谢。”“不客气。”陆赫扬说完，抬腿上台阶，进了游泳馆。他边走边将手环的档位调高，以彻底隔绝陌生的、富有压迫性的s级alpha信息素。许则的信息素。alpha的信息素在易感期来临时会变得更加浓烈，而许则的旧手环显然已经没办法压制住这种浓度的信息素。许则是从特殊通道出去的，他的信息素已经开始扩散，如果往学生人群里走，会影响到其他AO。他一边匆匆往前走一边从口袋里拿出一张抑制贴，用嘴咬下涂布层，抬手将抑制贴按在后颈上。特殊通道尽头是一间专用休息室，许则在门口做了面容录入，然后推开门。他大口喘气，甚至来不及走到沙发边，直接沿着墙坐在地上，将袋子里的东西倒出来。手在发抖，许则用牙齿撬开碘伏棉签瓶盖，抽了一根棉签——动作太忙乱，棉签瓶被放下的时候倒了，许则只是看了眼，没时间在意。他握着棉签棒在手臂内侧用力涂几下，接着撕掉注射器包装，掰开试剂瓶，抽取抑制剂，一针打进静脉里。他本来能熬到回家之后再做这些的，但短时间内情绪的剧烈波动会促进信息素分泌，从而推动易感期迅速到来。而造成他短时间内情绪剧烈波动的原因——许则喘息沉重地闭上眼，强迫自己不去回想。--------------------【陆赫扬：怀疑17号在预备校，但没完全怀疑】【设定是这样的，手环档位越高，隔绝他人信息素和抑制自己信息素的效果越好】

Amidst the commotion, the kick-off whistle sounded. In the blink of an eye, Owen threw a straight punch. No. 17 reacted quickly and raised his elbow to block and sidestepped."These gloves are really thin. They don't even have 8 ounces. They're probably only 6. It's easy to break the finger bones." He Wei chewed gum, "But in a place like this, people who wear thick gloves usually have tricks." He leaned over, made a fist with one hand, and hit Lu Heyang on the right rib: "Someone will put broken glass in the gloves., punch it under the ribs, right here - the liver, and the person on the other side will not even think about it."In the underground arena, most of the boxers played dirty, and the spectators didn't care, and even cheered for it - they came here for the excitement and the smell of blood, and they wished the scene could be more crazy and brutal.Within ten seconds of the start, No. 17 was clearly at a disadvantage. Owen kept interfering with his offensive rhythm with extremely fast jabs, while constantly attacking his head and lower abdomen.No. 17 retreated one after another, and was about to retreat to the edge of the Octagon.Many spectators had already stood up from their seats, shouting: "Fuck him, fight back! Fuck him!" Owen relied on his weight advantage and began to use heavy punches to break No. 17's block.During the continuous defense, No. 17's left-hand block was broken by Owen, and then Owen took the opportunity to swing a straight fist and hit him in the face. Bright red nosebleeds spurted out and splashed on the gray rubber mat under his feet.The screams and shouts were deafening. Some people had gathered around the Octagon like a swarming ant colony, grabbing the steel wire and shouting at the boxers inside.It doesn't matter whether you are scolding or encouraging. This kind of competition is just to stimulate the adrenaline of the audience, using the boxers' fighting and blood for them to vent their anger, excitement, joy... As long as you provoke any one of them, it will be considered a success."How many rounds are there in a game?" Lu Heyang asked suddenly as he looked at No. 17, who was leaning against the wire mesh with his head down and wiping blood with his elbow."The competition system here doesn't have rounds. It ends when one of the players can't get up." He Wei rested his elbows on his knees, leaned forward, and stared at the arena. "It's usually like this. Sometimes there will be a ring match." In the octagonal cage, No. 17 slowly straightened up, raised his hand, lightly bumped the two gloves, and then walked back to the center of the arena.Owen twisted his neck and stood on the spot. When No. 17 came up to him, he stuck out his tongue and made an insulting face in a provocative manner. The venue suddenly became ebullient again, with people shouting and applauding. However, No. 17 did not seem to be affected. He folded his arms and returned to the ready position, arching his back slightly.Another series of rapid jabs, and No. 17 was hit in the nose again. Blood flowed down his thin chin, mixed with the paint on his face, making him look like a mess.Owen approached him arrogantly, punching towards his vitals.No. 17 was forced to the edge again. Lu Heyang heard the spectators who had placed bets on No. 17 swearing curses and complaining about how he couldn't beat a new boxer... But suddenly, those curses turned into excited exclamations, because No. 17, who had been in a defensive position, suddenly ducked down and changed the fighting position, and then hit Owen's chin with an uppercut.The punch was real and knocked Owen into a daze. He reacted and resumed the attack. No. 17 continuously dodged and made a fake punch straight to the abdomen, followed by a right hook that accurately hit Owen on the left side of the face.Before anyone could see what he was doing, Owen's head had already tilted to one side, and his mouthguard was stained with bloody saliva and was knocked out of his mouth.No. 17 is like a snow leopard that wakes up and explodes with power. He is calm, decisive, and quick. He punches cleanly and hits the target with one hit, gradually forcing Owen into a corner.That calm and domineering aggression without hesitation turned into one straight punch after another, bursting out like lightning falling to the ground, igniting the entire venue, and the crowd's shouts were about to break their eardrums."How smart! Knowing these people, just take this bite to reverse the situation." He Wei stood up from his position, all the muscles in his body tensed with excitement.At the last moment, No. 17 threw a powerful backhand punch, hitting Owen right in the face.Owen raised his head and spat out a mouthful of blood. He hit the wire mesh backwards and was bounced back, lying straight on the ground.The blood slowly dripped under his head. Owen tried to get up with his hands on his hands, but fell back every time. Apparently, he no longer had the ability to fight back."Get up if you're not dead! Fight!" "Keep fighting! Fight!" "Don't stop! Beat him to death!" The audience waved their fists and screamed. The referee did not stop or count the seconds, which meant that No. 17 could continue to punch. No rules apply here. If he wanted to, he could beat Owen until he twitched and passed out on the stage, letting the blood flow a little more, satisfying the cruel and bloodthirsty wishes of the spectators.But No. 17 just crossed his arms and made a stop motion, then took off the snare and mouthguard, pushed open the door of the Octagon, and walked backstage through the players' tunnel.Many people shouted and threw wine bottles and cigarette butts into the Octagon and threw them around Owen or on his back, but soon someone came in with a stretcher and carried Owen away.The field is cleared, new boxers enter, and a new match begins.He Wei sat back down. The chewing gum in his mouth had no taste anymore, but he was still chewing: "It's really exciting. The abdominal muscles and chest muscles of No. 17 are so beautiful, as well as those waist and legs." "More than that." Lu Heyang said."What?" "The back muscles are also good." After saying that, Lu Heyang stood up and walked out."Don't watch it?" He Wei asked him."Go out and get some air."

At around eleven o'clock in the evening, the two left the underground club.He Wei drove the car and suddenly said: "Since No. 17 is S-class, if there is a record in the file, the preparatory school should have looked for him. Even if he has no money to study, the school will give him free tuition and subsidies. As for coming to boxing?" Lu Heyang leaned on the back of his chair: "Maybe he is too short of money." "Actually, there is not much money to be made in a place like this. If you really want to make money, you must make more by working professionally. The commercial value is completely different." He Wei said, "Looking at the appearance of No. 17, I guess he is too short of money."I have received professional training before, so I don’t know why I am hanging around here.”“Maybe—” Lu Heyang looked at the road ahead, put his right hand on his knee, and tapped his knee a few times with the tip of his index finger, and continued, “It will be in the preparatory school on the 17th.He Wei was startled, turned to look at him, and then laughed: "Impossible, how is it possible?""Yeah."Lu Heyang responded, "I think so."On Monday, after the last class, Lu Heyang went to the swimming pool to wait for He Wei.The sky was very cloudy, as if it was going to rain, and it was so stuffy that people couldn't breathe.Lu Heyang walked around the flower bed and walked up the steps of the swimming pool. He met an alpha coming out of it, holding a plastic bag in his hand, his head lowered, and his steps were a little hurried.After Xu Ze took a step down, he realized there was someone. It was too late to avoid him. The moment he bumped into him, the other person's cold face flashed before his eyes at close range.Being too close, Xu Ze could even see his distinct eyelashes, which were long and black, and his pupils were also very dark. When he looked up, he seemed to have no warmth.He felt his upper arm being clasped by a hand for a moment. Logically speaking, after being supported for a moment, he should have stabilized - but Xu Ze staggered even more panicked and stepped into the grass on the side of the steps. The contents of the plastic bag fell out, making the sound of glass colliding.The dark clouds were heavy and heavy, as if they were about to press down.Xu Ze raised his head and glanced at Lu Heyang in a hurry. Then he quickly looked away, leaned down to pick up something on the ground, and said while picking up, "I'm sorry." His ears were a little red, and he looked very sorry indeed."It's my problem. I didn't step aside in time." Lu Heyang bent down to help him pick it up.Xu Ze's voice was low and hoarse, and his breathing was somewhat rapid. It was natural for people to think that he was sick and came to the infirmary for treatment.But Lu Heyang also saw at the same time that Xu Ze had gauze taped to his nose, with a small piece of purple skin exposed at the edge, and the corners of his mouth were a bit swollen. Just looking at his appearance, it looked more like he was getting medicine after a fight.However, what fell on the ground was not cold medicine or bruise medicine, but several disposable syringes and injection bottles.When picking up the last injection bottle, the two of them stretched out their hands at the same time, and their fingertips accidentally touched each other. Xu Ze instantly retracted his hand, and Lu Heyang picked up the bottle and saw the words "alpha inhibitor" printed on it.Lu Heyang was not familiar with alpha inhibitors. The S-class had a natural advantage in the self-control ability of pheromones. They generally would not go into heat without being severely stimulated. Even if a susceptible period occasionally appeared once or twice a year, it would only be a mild fever symptom, not serious.As an S-class, the use of alpha inhibitors is a very rare situation.Lu Heyang said nothing, and handed over the tube of inhibitor. Xu Ze reached out to take it, immediately stuffed it into a plastic bag, and whispered: "Thank you." "You're welcome." After Lu Heyang said that, he lifted his legs up the steps and entered the swimming pool.As he walked, he adjusted the setting of his bracelet to a higher level to completely isolate himself from the unfamiliar and oppressive S-level alpha pheromones.Xu Ze's pheromones.The alpha pheromone will become more intense when the susceptible period comes, and Xu Ze's old bracelet obviously can no longer suppress this concentration of pheromone.Xu Ze went out through a special passage. His pheromones had begun to spread. If he walked into the crowd of students, it would affect other AOs.As he hurried forward, he took out a suppressor patch from his pocket, bit off the coating with his mouth, and raised his hand to press the suppressor patch on the back of his neck.At the end of the special passage was a dedicated lounge. Xu Ze recorded his face at the door and then opened the door.He gasped for air and didn't even have time to walk to the sofa. He sat on the ground along the wall and poured the contents out of the bag.With his hands shaking, Xu Ze used his teeth to pry open the cap of the iodophor cotton swab bottle and took out a cotton swab - his movements were too hectic and the cotton swab bottle fell over when he put it down. Xu Ze just glanced at it and had no time to care.He held the cotton swab and applied it vigorously on the inside of his arm a few times, then tore off the syringe package, opened the reagent bottle, extracted the inhibitor, and injected it into the vein.He could have waited until he got home to do this, but the violent mood swings in a short period of time would promote the secretion of pheromones, thus pushing the susceptible period to come quickly.The cause of his violent mood swings in a short period of time - Xu Ze breathed heavily and closed his eyes, forcing himself not to think about it.--------------------[Lu Heyang: I suspect that No. 17 is in the preparatory school, but I don't fully suspect it] [The setting is like this. The higher the bracelet level, the better the effect of isolating other people's pheromones and suppressing one's own pheromones]
title_en: Recommended popular novels that have been completed
content_zh:
鼎沸喧哗中冲出一声开赛哨响，眨眼的功夫，Owen出了记直拳，17号反应迅速地抬肘格挡，侧闪躲过。“这拳套真薄，8盎司都没有吧，估计只有6，容易把指骨打断。”贺蔚嚼着口香糖，“不过在这种地方，一般戴厚拳套的都有猫腻。”他靠过去，单手握拳，在陆赫扬右侧肋骨上挨了挨：“有人会在拳套里塞碎玻璃，往肋骨下面，就这儿——肝的位置，砸一拳过去，对面的人就别想起来了。”地下场子里，拳手大多玩得脏，看客们并不在意，甚至还为此欢呼喝彩——本就是奔着刺激和血腥味来的，巴不得场面再疯狂惨烈一点。开场没十几秒，17号明显落了下风，Owen一直用速度极快的刺拳干扰他的进攻节奏，同时不断攻击他的头部和下腹。17号接连后退，眼看就要退到八角笼边缘。不少观众已经从位置上站起来，嘶吼大喊：“他妈的反击啊！干他！”Owen凭借量级优势，开始用重拳破17号的格挡。在持续的防守中，17号的左手格挡被Owen攻破，紧接着Owen借机挥起直拳正面砸在他脸上，鲜红的鼻血登时喷出来，溅在脚下灰色的橡胶垫上。尖叫和呼喊声震耳欲聋，有人已经围到八角笼附近，像汹涌的蚁群，抓着钢丝网冲里面的拳手大喊。到底是在斥骂还是鼓励都不重要，这种比赛只为刺激观众的肾上腺素，用拳手的搏斗和鲜血供他们放肆发泄，愤怒、激动、欢畅……只要挑起其中任何一种，就算成功。“一场打几个回合？”陆赫扬看着低头背靠在钢丝网边用手肘擦血的17号，忽然问。“这儿的赛制没有回合一说，打到其中一个人完全爬不起来就算结束。”贺蔚手肘撑在膝头，身体往前倾，盯着赛场，“一般是这样，有些时候会开擂台赛。”八角笼里，17号缓缓直起身，抬手，两只拳套轻轻一撞，然后走回场地正中。Owen扭了扭脖子，在原地开脚站架，等17号走到面前，他吐着舌头挑衅地做了个充满侮辱性的鬼脸，场上顿时又沸腾起来，大骂的叫好的，不过17号似乎并没受到什么影响，他收拢双臂恢复预备姿势，微微弓起背。又是一连串飞速的刺拳，17号再次被击中鼻子，血顺着他尖瘦的下巴往下流，混合着脸上的油彩，看起来一塌糊涂。Owen气焰嚣张地向他逼近，拳拳朝着要害去。17号又被逼到了边缘位置，陆赫扬听见周围那些给17号下了注的观众纷纷骂起脏话，抱怨他怎么连个新来的拳手都打不过……但忽然间，那些骂声又化成了兴奋的惊呼，因为一直处于防守地位的17号忽然下潜闪身转换了交锋位置，接着回手一个上勾拳打中Owen的下巴。这一拳实实在在，把Owen打得有些懵，反应过来后重新发起进攻，17号连续闪过，出了一个直拳击腹的假动作，随后紧跟上一记右勾拳，准确击中Owen的左脸。在所有人还没有看清他的这套动作时，Owen的头已经歪到一边，护齿沾着带血的唾液，直接从嘴里被打了出来。17号像只苏醒后力量爆发的雪豹，沉静、果断、迅速、出拳干脆、一击即中，反将Owen渐渐逼入角落。那种毫不迟疑的冷静的霸道侵略性化成一记接一记的直拳勾拳，闪电坠地似地迸开来，将整个场馆点燃，众人的高呼声快要撞破耳膜。“真聪明！知道这些人就吃这一口反转。”贺蔚从位置上站起来，浑身肌肉都亢奋地绷紧。最后一刻，17号出了一个力道十足的后手拳，正中Owen的面门。Owen仰头吐出一口血，整个人往后撞在钢丝网上，又被弹回来，直挺挺趴在地上。血在脑袋下慢慢淌开，Owen撑着手试图爬起来，但次次都摔了回去，显然已经不具备任何还击能力。“没死就起来！打！”“接着打！打啊！”“别停！打死他！”观众们挥舞着拳头嘶声呐喊，台裁没叫停也没读秒，意味着17号可以继续补拳——任何规则在这里都不适用，只要他想，他可以把Owen打到抽搐昏死在台上，让血流得再多一点，满足看客们残忍嗜血的愿望。但17号只是双手交叉做了个停止的动作，然后摘下圈套和护齿，推开八角笼的门，从选手通道走回后台。许多人大喊着把酒瓶和烟头扔进八角笼，扔到Owen周围或背上，不过很快就有人拿着担架进去，将Owen抬走。场地被清理干净，新的拳手上场，开始新的比赛。贺蔚坐回位置上，嘴里的口香糖已经没什么味道了，但他还在嚼：“真带劲，17号的腹肌和胸肌够漂亮的，那腰，那腿。”“不止。”陆赫扬说。“什么？”“背肌也不错。”说完，陆赫扬站起来往外走。“不看啦？”贺蔚问他。“出去透个气。”

晚上十一点多，两人离开地下俱乐部。贺蔚开着车，突然说：“17号既然是s级，如果档案有记录的话，预备校应该找过他啊。就算没钱读书，学校也会给他免学费和补贴，至于来打野拳么。”陆赫扬靠在椅背上：“可能太缺钱了。”“其实在这种地方赚不到多少钱，真要捞钱，肯定还是打职业赚得多，商业价值完全不一样。”贺蔚说，“看17号的样子，估计以前受过专业训练，不知道为什么在这儿混。”“说不定——”陆赫扬看着前路，右手搭在膝头，食指指尖在膝盖上轻轻点了几下，他接着说，“17号就在预备校里。”贺蔚一怔，转头看了他一眼，接着笑起来：“不可能吧，怎么可能啊。”“嗯。”陆赫扬应了声，“我也觉得。”周一，最后一节课下课，陆赫扬去游泳馆等贺蔚。天很阴，像是要下雨，闷得人喘不过气。陆赫扬绕过花坛，往游泳馆台阶上走，正遇到一个alpha从里面出来，手上拎着塑料袋，低着头，脚步有点急。许则往下迈了一个台阶后才意识到有人，想躲避已经来不及，撞上去的那刻，对方那张冷淡的面容近距离地在眼前闪过。太近了，许则甚至能看到他根根分明的睫毛，长而黑，瞳孔也很黑，抬眼看过来的时候，显得没什么温度。他感觉自己的上臂被一只手扣住片刻，按理说，被扶了那么一下，他应该站稳了的——但许则反而更慌乱地趔趄了一步，一脚踩进台阶侧边的草地，塑料袋里的东西掉出来，发出玻璃碰撞的声音。乌云阴沉沉的，仿佛要压下来了。许则抬头看了陆赫扬一眼，匆忙的一眼，接着他很快移开视线，俯身去捡地上的东西，边捡边说：“对不起。”他的耳朵有点红，看起来确实是十分抱歉的样子。“是我的问题，没及时往旁边让。”陆赫扬弯腰帮他捡。许则的声音低哑，呼吸也有些急促，让人理所当然地以为他是生病了，来医务室看病。但陆赫扬同时也看见，许则的鼻子上贴着纱布，边缘露出一小块青紫色皮肤，嘴角也有点肿，如果光看他这模样，又更像是跟人打完架之后来配药。不过掉在地上的并不是感冒药或跌打药，而是几支一次性注射器和针剂瓶。捡最后一个针剂瓶时，两人同时伸出手，指尖不小心碰在一起，许则瞬间收回手，陆赫扬于是把瓶子捡起来，看到上面印着“alpha抑制剂”的字样。陆赫扬对alpha抑制剂不太熟悉，s级在信息素的自控能力方面有天生优势，在没有受到严重刺激的情况下一般不会发情，就算一年中很偶然地出现一两次易感期，也仅仅是轻微的发热症状而已，严重不到什么地步。作为s级，用到alpha抑制剂算是种很罕见的情况。陆赫扬什么也没说，把那管抑制剂递过去，许则伸手接下，立刻塞进塑料袋里，低声说：“谢谢。”“不客气。”陆赫扬说完，抬腿上台阶，进了游泳馆。他边走边将手环的档位调高，以彻底隔绝陌生的、富有压迫性的s级alpha信息素。许则的信息素。alpha的信息素在易感期来临时会变得更加浓烈，而许则的旧手环显然已经没办法压制住这种浓度的信息素。许则是从特殊通道出去的，他的信息素已经开始扩散，如果往学生人群里走，会影响到其他AO。他一边匆匆往前走一边从口袋里拿出一张抑制贴，用嘴咬下涂布层，抬手将抑制贴按在后颈上。特殊通道尽头是一间专用休息室，许则在门口做了面容录入，然后推开门。他大口喘气，甚至来不及走到沙发边，直接沿着墙坐在地上，将袋子里的东西倒出来。手在发抖，许则用牙齿撬开碘伏棉签瓶盖，抽了一根棉签——动作太忙乱，棉签瓶被放下的时候倒了，许则只是看了眼，没时间在意。他握着棉签棒在手臂内侧用力涂几下，接着撕掉注射器包装，掰开试剂瓶，抽取抑制剂，一针打进静脉里。他本来能熬到回家之后再做这些的，但短时间内情绪的剧烈波动会促进信息素分泌，从而推动易感期迅速到来。而造成他短时间内情绪剧烈波动的原因——许则喘息沉重地闭上眼，强迫自己不去回想。--------------------【陆赫扬：怀疑17号在预备校，但没完全怀疑】【设定是这样的，手环档位越高，隔绝他人信息素和抑制自己信息素的效果越好】
